token.title: 🔑 GitHub tuukan
token.intro: GitHub kiggutiruq 60 apiqsruutinik sassamun tuukanmik tuyuġŋitchuanun. Avguġaat napaaqtuŋat iḷuqaan 32 missaaŋanik atuqtuq, taatnaqłuni tuglia tikiññiq nuŋuruq. Tuukan killiq 5000-mun sassamun qutchiksitchiruq.
token.step1: Aŋmaġuŋ Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, tavra Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: iliptiŋ atiġun. Expiration: uvluq sumik, napaaqtuq takiruamik piyumaŋŋitchuq.
token.step4: Aŋiqsiutit iḷuqaisa aktuġnaġŋitchut. Iḷiġvium iñuŋnun meta-ŋa atausiġmiñ piyumaŋŋitchuq.
token.step5: Sanaġuŋ, tavra kopiġuŋ {token} naliġutaa. GitHub atautchimik kisiŋa tautuktitchiruq.
token.classic: Utuqqaq tuukan savaktuq-guuq: sanaġuŋ atausiq killiġmik tiguaŋŋitchuq. Killiq imaiŋŋuaq iñuŋnun ilitchuġiksrat taiguaġai nalunaiqsiŋaruat sukaitilaaŋatigun.
token.stays: Qiñiqtuutmi uvani iḷiŋaruq aŋmaun {key} ataani, {host}-mun kisiŋa aullaqtuq. Aqqutim titiġaŋanun aglaġŋitchuq qaŋaġluunniiñ, taatnaqłuni katiġun piqatigiikkaŋŋi qiñiġusiq kisiŋa, nalunaiqsiun naagga. Naqitaq iḷiġviam ataani piiġiniaġaa iḷiġaġlu.
token.persistHow: Iḷiuŋ tuukan savaqtuum {env} makpiġaaŋanun, makpiġaaq una iḷiġvigikkaŋa, {port} saniġaanun:
token.proxy: aullaġuŋlu {make}-mik. Iḷiuqtaaq tavra nginx iḷaŋanik aglaktuq, {header} niaquq {path} akunŋuuŋanun qiḷiġaa, taatnaqłuni qiñiqtuun iŋmi aullaġviŋanik tuqłuġaa tuukanmiklu tiguŋŋitchuq qaŋaġluunniiñ. Iḷiġviaq una tammaqtuq, tikiññiaġaqtuat iḷuqaan kisitchiuŋŋa 5000-mik sassamun piqatigiiktut.
